## Description
Provide a concise explanation of the changes made and the motivation behind them.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality or layer)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature causing existing code not to work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance / Metal GPU optimization

## Checklist
- [ ] My code conforms to Swift 6 Strict Concurrency rules (`Sendable` compliance, no data races).
- [ ] I have verified that `swift build` passes with zero errors and warnings.
- [ ] I have added appropriate docstrings and unit tests where applicable.
- [ ] I have verified that no external weights/model dependencies are imported.
